species.name: Dishfin

dex.text: A big flat dish with a face on it and a tiny mouth, floating on its side in the sun. It looks like the front half of a fish and has not ordered the rest.
dex.fact: The ocean sunfish is often seen basking at the surface off Cornwall and Wales in summer, lying on its side to warm up.

species.real: A sunfish has no real tail; it steers with a rounded rudder-like fin called a clavus.

species.name: Moladisc

dex.text: A huge, flat, blotchy disc with a gull on its back, who is doing the cleaning and the sightseeing. It floats about as though the sea owed it a favour.
dex.fact: The ocean sunfish is the heaviest bony fish in the world, and big ones can weigh more than a tonne.

species.real: A female ocean sunfish can produce hundreds of millions of eggs at once, more than any other known vertebrate.
